mappings.testId: bun:tests/unit/docx-page-layout.test.ts:final section geometry executes22 saved outcomes and atomic refusals
outcomes: The wrapper reports no failures and 22 passed examples. Pinned bindings compare all requested page fields, receipt, text and XML width/height after byte reopen; nongeometry main source and all other payloads stay exact, and refusals preserve archive bytes and paragraph identity.
gaps: Only two aggregate assertions occur here; semantic predicates are delegated to the pinned bindings. save() has no path, so these are byte reopen checks with no path save. Refusal codes are only constrained to the docx- prefix. No rendering, pagination or independent-reader credit.
